portwatch.notes: Daily vessel transits by type and deadweight tonnage, estimated from AIS signals. Export of 31 October 2026 (data to 25 October 2026), taken from a public copy at github.com/jhelvy/2026-global-oil-flows. PortWatch revises past days. Cite as IMF PortWatch; IMF terms apply.

eia-chokepoints.notes: Crude oil and petroleum liquids, million barrels a day. 1H25 = first half of 2025. Suez includes the SUMED pipeline; Panama is by fiscal year. The Cape of Good Hope is a route, not a chokepoint. Danish Straits are shown at the Oresund and Turkish Straits at the Bosporus.
